actual: REPRODUCE: ask '给我国城矿业 基本情况/近期走势/未来趋势 全方位分析' -> reply is the fail-closed text 'Insufficient evidence: business reply synthesis did not pass grounding guard.' Evidence WAS gathered (stock_analysis_evidence_card business synthesis path ran), but the model's synthesized answer was rejected by compose_with_evidence_guard (react_grounding.py:423) and fell back via _business_synthesis_failure_text (service.py:4184). ROOT CAUSE: (1) Guard requires the answer to contain, as a verbatim case-insensitive substring, BOTH a known source value (_has_inline_source, react_grounding.py:352) AND a known as_of value (_has_inline_as_of:357). For a multi-tool comprehensive stock answer (quote+financials+fund_flow+technicals+web fundamentals), the real model paraphrases sources (e.g. says '根据资金流数据' instead of reproducing the literal source_ref token like 'stock-analysis:fund_flow:...') and there are multiple per-tool as_of values, so verbatim matching fails -> missing_inline_tool_evidence / unsourced_numeric_fact. (2) NO regeneration loop: design 4.6 requires 'on violation re-prompt the model with the reason and regenerate (bounded N) before fail-closing', but the agentic path fail-closes immediately on the first guard miss (no retry/regenerate found in react_grounding/service). (3) Helper _append_missing_evidence_citation/_evidence_citation_suffix exist but are not wired to rescue otherwise-grounded answers. IMPACT: the flagship comprehensive multi-source analysis returns 'insufficient' for answerable questions; the fake-LLM 7.3 test passes because the fake crafts a guard-passing string, but real models do not. FIX DIRECTION (must NOT weaken anti-hallucination): implement bounded regeneration that re-prompts the model with the exact source/as_of tokens to cite; and/or make citation detection robust for multi-source synthesis (accept per-tool/per-section citation, wire _append_missing_evidence_citation to attach the evidence suffix when answer is otherwise grounded, give the model the exact source/as_of strings in the synthesis prompt). ACCEPTANCE: add a test with a REAL-style model output that paraphrases sources -> guard either passes via robust detection or triggers bounded regeneration that yields a cited answer; the guocheng comprehensive question returns a synthesized cited analysis, not fail-closed; anti-hallucination still rejects truly unsourced/placeholder/fabricated answers. CONSTRAINTS: fix in worktree not root; no service start; no DDL. Related: BUG-403 (this path), BUG-412 (tool coverage), BUG-404 (graceful turn errors).
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
